analysis.title: Robinhood Markets Inc. (HOOD) Monthly: Robust October net deposits vs. softer volumes
key_insights: HOOD October net deposits rose about $9.0bn sequentially to $15.1bn, including about $6.5bn from Trump Accounts. That is a 46% annualized growth rate against September 2026 assets (26% excluding Trump Accounts), versus the company's 20% annual net new assets guidance.
Funded accounts rose about 200k MoM to 28.9mn, up about 8% YoY (8.4% annualized growth rate vs 4.2% in September).
Crypto volumes fell 21% MoM and 48% YoY to $17bn. Robinhood App crypto volume was $6.8bn (-24% MoM, -51% YoY) and Bitstamp was $10.2bn (-18% MoM, -46% YoY).
Net securities lending revenue was negative for a third consecutive quarter at -$12mn. Total securities lending revenue rose to $34.0mn (+6% MoM, -43% YoY).
Total platform assets, which include Trump Accounts custodied by HOOD, fell 3% MoM to $383.2bn, up 12% YoY. Margin balances rose 4% MoM to $22.9bn (+39% YoY). Cash sweeps fell 5% MoM to $30.8bn.
Event contract (prediction markets) contracts rose 5% MoM to 5.9bn, up 136% YoY. Commissions per day from event contracts were $2.2mn (+99% YoY).
Equity volumes grew 1% MoM to $325.5bn (+2% YoY). Option contracts were flat MoM (+8% YoY). Commissions per day were $11.3mn, down 6% MoM and 7% YoY, on 2% lower total commissions.
App downloads fell about 11% MoM in October to about 451k, versus a roughly 562k 2025 monthly average. About 88% of 2026 year-to-date downloads are in the US.
GS cut 2026E/27E net interest income by 1% on lower platform assets, with total revenue essentially unchanged. 2026E/28E adjusted EPS fall 1% on average.
GS cut its Q5-Q8 P/E multiple by 3.5x to 31.5x on lower market multiples, which lowers the 12-month price target 10% to $115 from $128. Rating stays Buy, with 41.4% upside from $81.35.

market_movers.rationale: Price target cut to $115 from $128 on a lower target P/E multiple (31.5x, down 3.5x) reflecting lower market multiples. Estimates trimmed about 1% on lower platform assets.

earnings_insights: GS 2026E EPS $2.37 (old $2.40), 2027E $3.17 (old $3.18), 2028E $3.79 (old $3.81). These are GS estimates, not reported figures.
GS revenue estimates: 2026E $5,314.8mn (old $5,311.9mn), 2027E $6,958.3mn (old $6,965.9mn), 2028E $8,189.4mn (old $8,206.0mn). Estimates. 2025 revenue of $4,473.0mn is the reported base.
GS projects 2026E net revenue growth of 18.8%, 2027E 30.9% and 2028E 17.7%. 2026E EPS growth is -0.5%, then +39.3% in 2027E.
crypto_views: Robinhood crypto volumes fell 21% MoM and 48% YoY in October to $17bn. Crypto notional per trading day was $0.6bn, down 23% MoM.
Crypto DATs fell 3% MoM to 0.7mn. Crypto commissions per day were $1.0mn, down 26% MoM and 66% YoY.
Crypto take rate (GS estimate) fell to 0.19% from 0.20% in September and 0.29% a year earlier.
risk_factors: Lower interest rates reducing the net interest income growth trajectory.
Weaker cross-sell of new products to the user base at lower margins.
vol_and_positioning: Margin balances of $22.9bn are up 39% YoY and 22% above the prior 12-month average.
Cash sweep balances of $30.8bn are down 10% YoY and 2% above the prior 12-month average.
Share of DATs in stocks and options rose 220bps MoM to 90.0%.

tension_points.bull_case: Net deposits of $15.1bn (26% annualized ex Trump Accounts) are well ahead of the 20% NNA guidance. Funded accounts hit 28.9mn and margin balances rose 4% MoM to $22.9bn. Event contracts grew 5% MoM.
tension_points.bear_case: Crypto volumes fell 21% MoM and 48% YoY, net securities lending revenue stayed negative at -$12mn, platform assets fell 3% MoM, and app downloads fell 11% MoM to about 451k.
